reasoning_content: Now the mariadb volume is deleted, so I need to reimport dump. Start and check LDAP.

action.command:
su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev start 2>&1' | tail -15; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "=== ldap users ==="; sleep 2; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap bash -c 'ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b dc=example,dc=org -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w admin "(uid=user1)" uid mail 2>&1 | tail -20'
